title: Cross-pair numerical candidate identity versus arithmetic correctness
question: Across multiple fixed numerical candidate pairs, do the causal effects of L1H0, L3H3, and L4H0 track the semantically correct arithmetic answer, or do they track particular candidate-token identities?

interpretation_rule.canonical_margin: LOWER candidate logit minus UPPER candidate logit at the first discriminative token.
interpretation_rule.negative_ablation_delta: The intact head causally supports the LOWER candidate relative to the UPPER candidate.
interpretation_rule.positive_ablation_delta: The intact head causally supports the UPPER candidate relative to the LOWER candidate.
interpretation_rule.positive_correctness_effect: The intact head causally supports the semantically correct candidate.
interpretation_rule.negative_correctness_effect: The intact head causally suppresses the semantically correct candidate.
